title: 'Satiating Bloodlust' Of Society: Allahabad High Court's Justice Atul Sreedharan Slams 'Bulldozer Actions' To Punish Accused
description: Making strong observations regarding the UP Government's recent "bulldozer actions", Justice Atul Sreedharan of the Allahabad High Court on Monday said that the State is demolishing the houses of persons accused of an offence "to satiate the perceived blood lust of a society fed on a staple diet of bulldozer justice".
